main.description: Lists messages in a channel, newest first by default. Messages from the repo-backed channel this one was migrated from are included and marked legacy.

channel.description: The channel to list messages from.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

reverse.description: Whether to return the oldest messages first instead of the newest.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user may not read this channel.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.description: No channel matches the given space reference.
